table.swipe: Swipe horizontally to see all columns
table.houseCols: Columns = houses from Lagna (JHora style). Values are the same sign-based bindus (strength points).
table.noteMandala: Mandala → Trikona (trine houses: 1, 5, 9) → Ekadhipatya on SAV.
table.recalcSodhya: Recalculate the chart to load Sodhya Pindas (JHora).
table.sodhyaMethod: From Sodhita BAV × Rasi/Graha gunakara (same method as Jagannatha Hora).

charts.title: D-1 Ashtakavarga Charts
charts.intro: Sign-based Bhinna Ashtakavarga (JHora/Parasara) oriented from Ascendant ({asc}).
charts.asNote: As BAV = classical Lagna Ashtakavarga (49 bindus), not included in SAV 337.
charts.recalcLagna: Recalculate the chart to load classical Lagna Ashtakavarga and Sodhya figures.
charts.bySign: Values are by absolute sign, shown in the North Indian chart from your Ascendant.
charts.matrixIntro: Full Ashtakavarga matrix (JHora method). Use “From Lagna” to mirror JHora’s house columns.

read.high: High support zone: {sign} is highly activated in SAV.
read.moderate: Moderate-high support zone: {sign} gives better outcomes than average.
read.caution: Caution zone: {sign} has low bindu protection; avoid rushed decisions.
read.watch: Watch zone: {sign} needs patience and better timing.
read.thumb: Transit thumb rule: prefer actions when a transit planet is in signs where its own BAV is 4+ and SAV is 28+.
read.dashaBody: {lord} mahadasha lord sits in natal H{house} ({sign}) with SAV {sav} → estimated expression ~{pct}% of significations. BAV of lord in that sign: {bav} ({quality}{suffix}).
read.transitHint: Confirm with Bhinnashtakavarga: under 4 weak, 4 borderline, 5 good, 6+ excellent. Best when SAV of the transit sign is also strong and dasha supports.
read.transitMissing: Transit data not available in this context.

insights.directionSub: Highest directional total = best growth axis
insights.compareSub: Relative to ~{avg} SAV average — class Part 4 patterns
insights.khandaSub: Bandhu · Sevak · Poshak · Ghatak — from original Lagna SAV
insights.ghatakCallout: Ghatak > 73 — caution with loans, hidden enemies, and excess display; correlate with lifestyle.
insights.planetHouseSub: Each planet's Bhinnashtakavarga in house order from the Lagna · 4+ supports, ≤3 strains
insights.heatmapAria: Bhinnashtakavarga bindus by planet and house
insights.dusthana: Classical: lower score here means fewer obstacles. Modern: 3/6/8/11 also fuel effort and recovery.
insights.bhavaSub: Make any house the Lagna: that house = BODY of the topic; the other 11 = LIFE of that topic only.
insights.fallbackCaution: Compare bindus (strength points) inside this topic only — not against other natal houses.
insights.guidedSub: Compare only inside this rotated topic
insights.keySub: Body · Resources · Struggle · Support · Sudden · Gains — class essentials
insights.allSub: All 12 relative houses — meanings are for this topic only
insights.yogasSub: Indicative classical bindu yogas — correlate with dasha and transit
insights.lagnaDetail: H1 ≥ 40 — person can weather weak houses
insights.troubledBody: Sum of SAV from H1 through H{house} × 7 ÷ 27{raw} — indicative challenge age
insights.prosperousBody: SAV of Ju (H{ju}) + Ve (H{ve}) × 7 ÷ 27{raw} — indicative prosperity age
insights.promoSub: (H10 + H6) mod janma-nakshatra number → count remainder from birth nakshatra
insights.recalc: Recalculate the chart to load Advanced Ashtakavarga insights.
insights.bodyLine: Body of {topic} · relative H1 (= natal H{house})

bav.needGrahas: Chart grahas are required for Bhinnashtakavarga guidance.
bav.trines: Trine signs to watch for Saturn gochar:
bav.rememberBody: Bhinnashtakavarga timings activate when dasha/antardasha supports and gochar hits the sensitive sign/degree (±1° often peaks the event; Moon degree refines the day).
bav.transitHint: Current transit planet in each natal BAV sign — low scores need caution when dasha also runs.
bav.transitMissing: Transit positions not available in this view.

extended.prastaraIntro: Prastara shows which of the 8 contributors (Su–Sa + Lagna) gave each bindu.
extended.recalcPrastara: Recalculate the chart to load Prastara Ashtakavarga contributor grids.
extended.recalcRekha: Recalculate the chart to load Rekha (56 − SAV) values.
extended.rekhaExplain: Rekhas = 56 − SAV bindus per sign (resistance measure).
extended.recalcSodhya: Recalculate the chart to load Sodhya Pinda interpretations.
extended.kakshyaExplain: Each sign has 8 kakshyas (3°45′ each). Favorable when the kakshya lord contributed a bindu in the planet BAV.
extended.recalcKakshya: Recalculate the chart to enable Kakshya degree-level transit timing.
